title: CBIC ने DGGI मामलों में GSTAT में विभागीय अपीलों के लिए प्रक्रिया स्पष्ट की
content:
# CBIC ने DGGI मामलों में GSTAT में विभागीय अपीलों के लिए प्रक्रिया स्पष्ट की

Ek important update hai! CBIC (Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs) ne GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) ke saamne departmental appeals file karne ki procedure clarify kar di hai, khaas karke un DGGI cases mein jahan Orders-in-Original Common Adjudicating Authority (CAA) ne pass kiye the.

Yeh clarification Circular No. 256/02/2026-GST dated July 25, 2026, ke through aayi hai aur iska aim hai procedural uniformity lana.

**Main Points of Clarification:**

*   **Order-in-Appeal Communication:** Appellate Authority ab order-in-appeal ko common portal par upload karegi aur iski copies CAA ke jurisdictional Commissioner ko bhi bhejegi.
*   **CAA के jurisdictional Commissioner का रोल:** CAA ke jurisdictional Commissioner order ko examine karenge, zaroorat padne par DGGI se comments lenge, aur phir concerned taxable persons ke jurisdictional Commissioners ko apni recommendations bhejenge.
*   **Reviewing Authority:** Har taxable person ka jurisdictional CGST Principal Commissioner/Commissioner hi Section 112(3) of CGST Act, 2017 ke under reviewing authority honge.
*   **Appeal Filing:** Agar reviewing authority appeal file karne ka decision leti hai, toh woh apne subordinate officer ko GSTAT mein appeal file karne ke liye direct kar sakte hain.
*   **Separate Appeals & Jurisdiction:** Har taxable person ke liye separate departmental appeal file karni hogi, aur yeh appeal us GSTAT Bench ke saamne hogi jiski us taxable person par territorial jurisdiction hai.
*   **Intimation:** Appeal file karne ke baad (ya appeal na karne ka decision lene par), jurisdictional Commissioner ko CAA ke jurisdictional Commissioner ko inform karna hoga.

Yeh steps jurisdictional ambiguities ko kam karne aur departmental appeals ki process ko streamline karne ke liye hain.
